description: Stock Strata v0.2.12 with stock OMP 18.18.0; qwen3.8-flash-next-coder-iq1_m on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090, native Windows, text only, 262,144-token context. Stock setup-derived thresholds and flags; no hardware qualification or inherited receipts. Stock engine environment pinned: gdn_stack (config env, stock values). Stock KV streaming off pinned: --kv-streaming off (KV stays in VRAM; no --kv-resident; batch row kernels stay on). Stock KV growth pinned: --kv-grow (KV takes VRAM only for reached cells; one GPU). Stock engine 0.1.58 defaults: int8 prompt attention on these CUDA cards; tool-call recovery for declared tools is on by default (no tool_call_recovery key is written or pinned), alongside always-on quoted-call, missing-function-closer, lenient non-string JSON argument and stray-think-closer repairs; calls inside fenced or indented code stay text (Strata#4702, #4703) and tools the conversation already called count as declared (Strata#4663). The automatic expert cache keeps about 256 MiB more VRAM free (Strata#4474). With pinned batch slots, conversation parking keeps the shared prefix (Strata#4420). Automatic RAM PLE residency applies only when table, expert arena and headroom fit; the PLE table lock is given back when it would starve the automatic conversation cache (Strata#4518), with Windows commit headroom unmeasured. The engine owns the all-experts-resident no-slot-loan default (STRATA_PF_W16_CACHE_MIB and STRATA_AUTO_NOBORROW are unpinned). Penalties count the reply (Strata#4590); Windows reports inherited low disk priority (Strata#4733); short arena RAM can fall back to file reads (Strata#4846), which start verification refuses. Stock drafting Auto keeps the MTP: Coder is not a DFlash2 model. Bare --prefill auto may take 32768-token chunks; a RAM guard steps the ceiling to 16384 or 8192. STRATA_NV_CHUNK remains unpinned. K-quant MMQ prompt kernels are the default for K-quant experts only. An Auto start short of GPU memory is retried with no drafter, which start verification refuses. Stream writes have a 60 s timeout. The automatic FP16 weight cache is Linux-only. This profile pins stock's Linux GDN tensor-core prompt defaults through the config's env. These SM120 cards use the wide-up and stream-split hyper-connection reads, now with exact 5-8 token decode kernels; single-card layer-major prefill stays off. Stock OMP 18.18.0 selects replace editing for Qwen3.8; no edit-mode override is pinned.
